method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); the date arithmetic (with Interpretation Act 1984 ss 61, 62) in one module, the rules in another, the questions in a seat module importing them; one regulative rule (s 28(3)(c), a bare DO) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain dates; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Civil Procedure (Representative Proceedings) Act 2022 (WA), No. 30 of 2022 (no amendments in the compilation table; Part 1 in operation 14 September 2022, the rest 25 March 2023), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_45801.txt, retrieved 2026-09-07; with the Rules of the Supreme Court 1971, version 09-am0-00 (from 11 December 2025), O. 18A rr. 2, 4, 5, retrieved 2026-11-06, and the Interpretation Act 1984 ss 61, 62, as deposited in their subjects. Amendments after retrieval are not in the texts.
